formula_injection.csv.message: Valid CSV text; cells beginning with =, +, -, @ must be treated as literal strings, never evaluated, and must be neutralized (leading apostrophe/quote) on any re-export to spreadsheet software.

formulas_cached.xlsx.message: Formula cells carry a cached <v> value (B3=SUM(A1:A3) cached as 60); ingestion reads the cached value and never evaluates the formula itself.

macro_enabled.xlsm.message: Package declares a macro-enabled content type and contains xl/vbaProject.bin; macro-enabled formats are rejected outright (design.md Sec 12 Validate step).

mislabelled_xlsx_as.csv.message: Magic-byte sniffing detects real OOXML/ZIP content despite the .csv extension; extension alone is not trusted (design.md Sec 12 Validate step). Ingest using the sniffed type.

oversized_file.message: File exceeds the configured size limit; rejected before full parse (trd.md Sec 35, fault F3).

zip_bomb.message: Decompression-ratio guard rejects before fully inflating the archive (trd.md Sec 35, fault F3).
